"$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-extension-sdk-check.js > /tmp/hermes-locale-handle-sdk-extension-check.json

 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-locale-handle-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-locale-handle-run.sh

Strict Locale separately has only its two pre-existing waived Realm failures; baseline unchanged.
